findings.title: Cash is up 1,006 while net receivables fall by the same amount. The company may have factored its receivables; nothing discloses it.
findings.source: Instructor manual, finding 1, as corrected in KEYS.md errata row 1

findings.title: Merchandise inventories more than double, which suggests a change of inventory method. The footnote on the change is missing.
Gross property and equipment is up 1,553 while accumulated depreciation barely moves. Depreciation is missing, or the method changed without a footnote.
Goodwill is up about 20%. Impairment cannot be reversed, so this implies an acquisition, and no footnote reports one.
Accounts payable is almost 30% lower. A change in payment policy is possible and should be confirmed in the footnotes.
Revenue is up about 6,000 while cost of sales is down more than 7,000. That points to a change away from the weighted average inventory method, with no footnote.
findings.source: Instructor manual, finding 6, as corrected in KEYS.md errata row 2

findings.title: Retained earnings equal the year's net earnings exactly, although the opening balance was 4,233. That implies 4,233 of distributions that nothing discloses.
findings.source: KEYS.md errata row 7. Not in the instructor manual.
